note: Lane swing_exec ports app/swing_execute.py and app/swing_live_gate.py. Neither mounts a route: POST /swing/execute and /swing/rearm are app/swing_desk.py's (the swing desk lane) and call execute_line / rearm_gtt. The confirm path is graded by the 58 Rust tests in src/lanes/swing/swing_exec/tests.rs (ported from tests/test_swing_execute.py); these cases pin the refusals that reach the execute module before any broker read, and that no order or GTT call reaches the replay Kite. Postgres backend: 5 of 5 EQUAL with equal order/GTT call logs (30 Oct 2026); risk_ledger.updated_at is the server's now(), masked as R8.6 documents. Review (30 Oct 2026) added nine cases on the bed's real expired sw_plan lines: 410 with the EXPIRED side effect and its re-post, 404 across plans, 400 on 'True', 422s, and the clock edges. public.sw_plan_line.updated_at is set by both stores' SQL `updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` (the server's clock, which the injected clock cannot reach), masked as <null>/<set> exactly like risk_ledger.updated_at (R8.6); every other column, including state EXPIRED, is graded.

cases.name: an unconfirmed swing line is refused 400 and sends nothing
an unknown swing plan is refused 404
a swing confirm without a line_id is FastAPI's 422
re-arming an unknown position is refused 404
confirm 'True' (not the exact string 'true') on a real expired line is 400 and leaves it PROPOSED
a real line confirmed against another plan's id is 404
a real plan past its 30 minutes is 410 and the PROPOSED line is marked EXPIRED
re-posting the expired line is 410 again (expiry is read before state) and sends nothing
an expired line confirmed after the close is still 410
a swing confirm without confirm is FastAPI's 422
re-arming with a non-integer position_id is FastAPI's 422
re-arming without confirm before the open is 400
